summary: Preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares itself as a trivial 'Hello ${name}!' monorepo test export, but its `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) probes for a local `bun` binary and, if absent, downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip`, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a bundled `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle heavily obfuscated with an obfuscator.io-style string-array table (`n7gIxM`) and rotator function, unrelated to the package's advertised one-line hello wrapper. The `setup.mjs` entrypoint itself is written with obfuscator.io-style `_0xNNNNNN` identifiers and property maps hiding string constants including `/etc/os-release` and `Alpine` platform probes. The alternate-runtime execution path lets the payload bypass Node-only inspection: `npm install` auto-executes opaque code the installer cannot audit under a freshly downloaded second-language interpreter.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
